text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah-baba! Please don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I know all too well the heartbreak of 
coming up short when it matters most!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Saying it out loud is making me lose 
confidence too... Maybe I'll save the 
spider plushie for another time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
